improvements.areaName: SEO Meta Description and OG Tags
improvements.suggestion:
<meta name="description" content="Gideon is your Claude-powered AI assistant for trade and business. Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support. Try three free searches, then join from US$2/day.">
<meta property="og:title" content="GDN AI – Gideon | Your AI Trade & Business Assistant">
<meta property="og:description" content="Meet Gideon, the Claude-powered assistant built for business owners, traders, and professionals. Instant AI answers, voice chat, and unlimited workspace access.">
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:image" content="https://gdn.ai/og-image.jpg">
<meta property="og:url" content="https://gdn.ai/">
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
<meta name="twitter:title" content="GDN AI – Gideon | AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant">
<meta name="twitter:description" content="Your Claude-powered assistant for trade and business. Try three free searches, then unlock unlimited access from US$2/day.">
improvements.rationale: These tags improve search engine visibility with a keyword-rich, benefit-focused meta description under 160 characters. The Open Graph and Twitter Card tags ensure professional, consistent previews when shared on LinkedIn, Facebook, or Twitter—critical for B2B audiences. Including the free trial and price anchors expectations and encourages clicks.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Partner"

Subheading: "Meet Gideon — get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support for your business decisions. Try 3 free searches, no card required."
improvements.rationale: The headline positions Gideon as a partner rather than just a tool, building trust with business professionals. The subheading quickly communicates the three core value props (instant answers, voice chat, professional support) while removing friction by highlighting the free trial and no credit card requirement. This addresses both what Gideon does and why visitors should try it immediately.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to become a member to continue. Membership starts from just US$2 per day, billed monthly—or save 30 percent with an annual plan. As a member, you unlock unlimited access to Gideon's workspace, voice chat, and professional trade and business support.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the conversion moment when free users hit the paywall. It removes uncertainty about what happens next, reinforces the low entry price, highlights the annual savings incentive, and reminds prospects of the full member benefits—all key factors in reducing drop-off at the paywall.
